[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Water (distilled or deionized water is recommended)

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Turn off your laptop and unplug it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Use a soft, dry cloth to wipe the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: Dampen a cloth with water (if needed).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Gently wipe the screen in a circular motion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 5: Use a cleaning solution (if necessary).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 6: Inspect and repeat if needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 7: Dry the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Important tips include avoiding household cleaners, paper towels, and compressed air.
